chunks: Therefore We have made it easy in your tongue, so that they may take warning.
ai.seo_question: Why was the Quran revealed in Arabic according to Surah Ad-Dukhan?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Ad-Dukhan (41:2) elucidates the divine wisdom behind revealing the Quran in the clear Arabic tongue of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), ensuring immediate comprehension for the Arab audience. Shia scholars emphasize that this linguistic accessibility serves as a catalyst for *tadhakkur* (remembrance and reflection), bridging the gap between the divine text and the human intellect to facilitate spiritual awakening.
